UserWardrobeProfile.title: User Wardrobe Profile
UserWardrobeProfile.description: Stores initialization metadata for a user's personal wardrobe.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the wardrobe owner.

initialized.description: Whether the starter wardrobe has been initialized for this user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the wardrobe profile was created.

WardrobeItem.title: Wardrobe Item
WardrobeItem.description: A single clothing item belonging to a user's wardrobe.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the item owner.

name.description: Clothing item label such as 'black short sleeve polo'.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the item was added.

/users/{userId}/items/{itemId}.description: Individual wardrobe clothing items owned by the user.
